method: Independent source/navigation and frozen-output challenge; reasoned timestamp counterexamples are source inspection, not new Rust executions

cases.input: SwiftLint README:482-487 has a SwiftLint documentation label under MegaLinter and says See its setup instructions
cases.challenge: An exact project-name documentation label could falsely qualify an integration page as docs.root
cases.disposition: Old value is wrong-scope for project root; narrow correction is supported by separate README Rule Directory plus exact header/breadcrumb navigation to project index. The integration link remains useful for its own task.

cases.input: MinIO README:139-153 explicitly names Client mc before linking its Quickstart Guide
cases.challenge: Matching docs.min.io domain and Quickstart Guide label do not establish the server getting_started field
cases.disposition: Client setup is a different subject. Server Install from Source and startup guidance at59-89 plus explicit #install-from-source reference99 supports the immutable README fragment. Runtime installation success is not asserted.

cases.input: SwiftLint retained target says SwiftLintCore0.65.1 Docs while source is a pinned README commit
cases.challenge: Page identity and HTTP200 could be misused as version/commit parity evidence
cases.disposition: They establish observed documentation navigation/identity only. Record/evidence explicitly retain unresolved source-commit/version parity and target mutability. No version matching or freshness guarantee follows.

cases.input: Corrected exact values are freshly assessed on October29 while generated_at remains October27/October4
cases.challenge: Fresh field evidence might be wrongly exported or record age refreshed
cases.disposition: Frozen exporter receipts omit both new doc assessments and retain facts/dates. Current public/evidence.rs48-54 requires checkedAt exactly equal generated_at. This omission is the existing contract, not missing correction storage.

cases.input: Hypothetical restored old valueJson with a matching record timestamp
cases.challenge: Timestamp equality alone might carry an assessment to a new fact
cases.disposition: Current source public/evidence.rs41-47 rejects bound/current value inequality before timestamp checks. This is a reasoned source-path counterexample; no live or frozen record was mutated.

cases.input: Hypothetical checkedAt backdating or advancing the whole generated_at to October29
cases.challenge: Either could force timestamp equality while misrepresenting observation time or uninspected record age
cases.disposition: Neither is warranted. Actual records preserve original factual age and use actual field observation time. Public assessment-contract changes need separate design/validation; this record correction should not alter that gate.

cases.input: Other old fieldEvidence remains unchanged and may export because its old checkedAt still equals generated_at
cases.challenge: Withdrawal of whole-record verification could be mistaken for fresh validation of every retained field
cases.disposition: Record becomes imported/medium, verified provenance removed, correction appendix supersedes historical auto-promotion. Other values/assessments remain uninspected and explicitly unrefreshed, not endorsed by this review.

cases.input: Author's README-only parser replays reproduce old links
cases.challenge: Data correction could be mistaken for a durable parser fix or individual tombstone
cases.disposition: The records are correct narrow corrections; generic importer durability remains separate. The author states no tombstone/full refresh proof. Parser amendment will receive a separate frozen independent review after stable handoff.
